## Context / Problem
The test suite (about 19,200 nodes, 20 to 25 minutes for `make verify`) carries four classes of tests that assert nothing about behaviour. 37 modules (7,000 LOC, 486 nodes) pin one-time module splits as permanent invariants: re-export identity, "leaf" import shape, LOC floors, "shim no longer reachable"; 39 real behaviour tests are trapped inside them. `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` (1,890 LOC, 37 tests) re-asserts workflow config snapshots that its own docstring says collapsed into one reusable workflow, and duplicates `scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py` and `tests/unit/test_gerrit_docs_only.py`. 30 modules re-run a `scripts/check_*.py` gate over the real tree, or grep the Makefile for its invocation, although `make lint` (`Makefile:266-439`) already runs the script in CI. Two whole-tree AST import scans duplicate what ruff's `flake8-tidy-imports` (TID251/TID253, ruff 0.16.3) expresses natively; the remaining scans cannot be expressed and stay. `pytest-split` is pinned but `.test_durations` is git-ignored, so no duration profile exists. The operator approved retiring these classes (2026-09-06). Every verdict is enumerated per file and per test node, with node arithmetic, on origin/main 083620b0 in this epic's first two comments (the held-out pair list is the first comment on the sibling merge epic). This epic touches only `tests/`, `scripts/`, `pyproject.toml`, `Makefile`, `.gitignore`, `.pre-commit-config.yaml`, and `docs/`, so it runs in parallel with the code epics.

Ratchet note: this epic creates no `tests/_*.py` helper, no check script, no workflow step, and no autouse fixture, so `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` kept `increased=0` throughout; `--update-stale` is not run here.

## Acceptance Criteria
Reworded 2026-10-26 from the plan-time numbers to what the stories delivered; each change is named under "Delivered differently from plan" below and each story's own evidence is on that story.
- [x] The seam/split guard modules are deleted and every trapped behaviour test collects at its named destination, reconciled from before/after collect runs (story 3f35-f1af-7a0f-4376: 464 nodes before = 147 kept + 43 moved + 274 deleted). Checked in the seam story.
- [x] `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` is collapsed onto one owner with the snapshot and duplicate tests deleted, a parametrized rule over the discovered reusable workflows backed by a non-vacuous floor test, and `scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py` runs from `make lint` (story bbce-1846-1dd1-49ca: 49 nodes before, 42 after). Checked in the parity story.
- [x] Every `scripts/check_*.py` has exactly one owner: `make lint` runs 25 of them (`check_adr_numbers.py` and `check_docs_index.py` were added), no pytest module re-runs a lint-owned script against the real tree, each script that keeps a non-lint owner is named with that owner in the story, and `tests/unit/test_make_lint_hygiene_wiring.py` is the single wiring census over the 25 lint-target scripts. Checked in the single-owner story.
- [x] `TID251` and `TID253` are enforced by ruff with a recorded red proof; the `tests.`-rooted import scan is deleted; the heavy-stack scan is narrowed to the imports nested inside a module-level block, which ruff cannot see; four ratchet tests pin the ruff settings. Checked in the ruff story.
- [x] `.test_durations` is committed over the default selection with every key a collected node id and no collected node without a key (19,862 keys, 0 and 0), accepted by pre-commit and documented in `docs/local-dev-env.md`. Checked in the durations story.
- [x] After each story `make verify` failed only on the 17 known arm64-host pandoc tests under `tests/unit/reconciler` (it cannot exit 0 on this host) and the story's Gerrit change reached `Verified +1`.

## Delivered differently from plan
- Counts: the seam story deleted 274, moved 43 and kept 147 (plan: 301, 39, 149); the parity story's figures are 49 to 42 nodes (plan: 25 kept, 11 deleted).
- Single-owner: 2 of the 3 plan-time CI-only scripts moved into `make lint`; `check_readme_quickstart.py` executes the quickstart and stays CI-owned. The census covers 25 scripts (plan: 28).
- Ruff: `TID253` only inspects top-level imports (ruff 0.16.3), so it misses a heavy import nested in a module-level `try`, `if` or `with`. The heavy-stack scan is therefore kept for those forms (`test_no_core_module_imports_heavy_stack_nested_at_module_scope`) instead of deleted, as this epic's context already allowed for scans that cannot be expressed natively.
- `make verify` never exits 0 on this host because of the 17 pandoc failures, so the criterion names them.
- The ratchet note below says `new=0`; `check_mechanism_delta.py --check` prints `new=25 increased=0`, the same before and after a757 (25 admitted entries unrelated to this epic), so `increased` stayed 0.

## Child decomposition
- S1 delete the seam/split guard modules and move their behaviour tests: criterion 1.
- S2 collapse the CI-parity guards: criterion 2; depends on S1.
- S3 one owner per `scripts/check_*.py`: criterion 3; depends on S2.
- S4 fold the two expressible import scans into ruff: criterion 4; depends on S3.
- S5 record per-test durations once: criterion 5; depends on S4.
